title: Greeting Neighbors Warmly
paragraphs: Sejak pindah ke apartemennya, Tariq membiasakan diri menyapa tetangganya dengan nama setiap kali berpapasan di lorong, bahkan kepada mereka yang baru sekadar ia kenal sekilas. Awalnya, beberapa tetangga terlihat terkejut, karena kebanyakan orang di gedung itu hanya mengangguk tanpa berbicara atau menghindari kontak mata sepenuhnya sambil memeriksa ponsel di dalam lift.

Selama beberapa bulan, Tariq menyadari lebih banyak penghuni mulai saling menyapa juga, dan percakapan kecil di lorong menjadi bagian normal dan disambut baik dalam keseharian semua orang, bukan lagi pengecualian yang canggung. Seorang tetangga kemudian memberitahunya bahwa sapaan sederhananya membuat gedung itu terasa tidak seperti tempat orang asing. Tariq menyadari bahwa kebiasaan adab kecil bisa diam-diam membentuk suasana seluruh komunitas.
answerKey: Since moving into his apartment building, Tariq makes a habit of greeting his neighbors by name whenever he passes them in the hallway, even the ones he barely knows beyond a quick exchange. At first, a few neighbors seem surprised, since most people in the building simply nod without speaking or avoid eye contact entirely while checking their phones in the elevator. Over several months, Tariq notices that more residents start greeting each other too, and small conversations in the hallway become a normal, welcome part of everyone's day rather than an awkward exception. One neighbor later tells him that his simple greetings made the building feel less like a place of strangers. Tariq realizes that a small habit of adab can quietly shape an entire community's atmosphere.
